note: Fixed narrator lines. They never contain guests' names. audio is the file name: a Show Pack keeps it in its own audio/ folder. Without the file, the line shows as a caption only.

lines.text: The grand pages turn, revealing a most puzzling modern dialect…
An immaculate deduction! Your lexicon is truly vast.
Alas, that meaning belongs in another tale entirely.
With the speed of a swooping griffin, the bonus is claimed!
Time has vanished into thin air! The chance slips away.
Let us invert the spell! Match the meaning to its word.
The scroll shows a razor-thin margin between our top scribes!
The vault seals once more. Go forth with your newfound wisdom!
